accepted.note: The singular greeting Sawubona ('I see you', to one person) is answered Ngikhona ('I am here'), NOT Sikhona. Sikhona ('we are here') answers the PLURAL Sanibonani ('I see you all'). Earlier corpus/prose wrongly paired Sawubona→Sikhona.
Plural greeting Sanibonani (to a group) is answered Sikhona ('we are here'). Use the plural pair only when the answerer speaks for a group; one-to-one beats use Sawubona→Ngikhona.
